sloka: तं समीक्ष्य महातेजा महेषुं तेन संहितम्।लक्ष्मणो ऽप्याददे बाणमन्यं भीमपराक्रमः ।। ६.९१.४७ ।।
transliteration: taṁ samīkṣya mahātejā maheṣuṁ tena saṁhitam।lakṣmaṇo 'pyādade bāṇamanyaṁ bhīmaparākramaḥ ।। 6.91.47 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith, angry with his uncle, staying in the midst of Rakshasas, seized a mighty strong best arrow gifted by Yama.
